Visitor preserves unknown HTML tags as raw HTML

```java title="Java"
import io.xberg.htmltomarkdown.*;

public final class Example {
    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        class _TestVisitor implements HtmlVisitor {
            @Override public VisitResult visitCustomElement(NodeContext ctx, String tagName, String html) {
                return new VisitResult.PreserveHtml();
            }
        }
        var visitor = new _TestVisitor();
        var result = HtmlToMarkdownRs.convert("<article><p>Article text</p><x-custom>Custom element with content</x-custom><p>More article text</p></article>", ConversionOptions.builder().withVisitor(visitor).build());
        System.out.println(result.content());
    }
}
```
